answer: Proof of Burn serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to gain network influence. This relic of scarce digital resources forces an attacker to finance every fake identity, turning the voyage toward dominance into an unsustainable drain on capital. As the cost scales linearly with identity count, an adversary faces an umber horizon where the expense of securing a majority share exceeds the potential economic utility gained from the attack.
